name: keep-awake
title: Keep Awake
description: Keep the computer awake (no sleep, display stays on) and optionally keep the Teams status available
author: mendyka

commands.name: keep-awake
commands.title: Keep Awake
commands.description: Keep the computer awake for a while or indefinitely, show the status and stop it

commands.name: toggle-keep-awake
commands.title: Toggle Keep Awake
commands.description: Switch Keep Awake on (default duration) or off – good for a hotkey

preferences.name: teamsPresence
preferences.title: Teams Presence
preferences.label: Keep the Teams status available
preferences.description: Presses the unused F15 key after 60 seconds without input so Teams (and other apps) do not switch to Away. This also prevents the automatic screen lock – lock manually when you leave.

preferences.name: keepDisplayOn
preferences.title: Display
preferences.label: Keep the display on
preferences.description: Otherwise only sleep is prevented and the display may turn off
